conventions.unit_s3_killing_shell: Delta_1 alpha=4 alpha, Ric(alpha)=2 alpha, so nabla^2 alpha=-2 alpha

cancellation_requirement.needed_for_zero_full_n1_block: connection + Ricci + projection + Hilbert-metric terms must cancel the principal-symbol matrix, not merely its trace.
cancellation_requirement.needed_for_absorption_route: the sum of all terms must match the predetermined pi^-4/P02 finite residue without a tunable coefficient.
cancellation_requirement.warning: principal piece alone is 16 times the q-overlap toy trace-square because the matrix is multiplied by -4 before squaring.

interpretation.claim: principal symbol is harmless on Killing n=1 shell
interpretation.reason: It is proportional to the already nonzero q-overlap matrix with factor -4 in the conformal slice.

interpretation.claim: principal piece alone proves C6 fails
interpretation.reason: Other mandatory terms can cancel it; the audit quantifies the cancellation burden only.

verdict: In the reduced conformal slice h=2qg, the principal-symbol part of delta Delta_1 on the n=1 Killing shell is -4 times the nonzero q-overlap matrix. Its weighted trace-square is therefore 1/9, not zero. This is not the full operator, but it shows that any C6 rescue must produce a concrete cancellation from connection, Ricci, projection, and Hilbert-metric terms.
